packageRules.description: Android build toolchain (Gradle, Android Gradle Plugin, Kotlin) must match what the framework supports: it moves with the framework upgrade, behind dashboard approval, never automerged

iOS toolchain (CocoaPods and the Ruby gems behind it) in its own group. Routine updates and its lock refresh merge by themselves: verify's ios job runs bundle exec pod install and an unsigned Release build, and on an ios-toolchain branch that build always blocks (verify-plan drops ios from known-failing there). Majors still need dashboard approval
React Native core moves as one lockstep set; placed after default rules so it wins
